subject: Mercari renewal - ask for senior approval: concession + SLA addendum
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mercari renewal - ask for senior approval: concession + SLA addendum

Marissa / Ben —

Quick background: Mercari (marketplace, strong usage of embeddings + chat endpoint) is up for renewal; annual spend today is $1.2M TCV. They’ve indicated they will move to a competitor unless we provide meaningful concessions. I ran the numbers with finance and Product; here's the customer request and my recommended concession package to preserve the account.

Customer asks (Mercari leadership)
- 25% list discount on annual TCV
- One-time retention credit to offset migration costs
- Firm SLA commitment with contractual 99.9% availability credit for the first 12 months
- Ability to reset the term to calendar year to align with their procurement window

My recommended package (to keep within margin guardrails):
- 18% recurring discount across platform fees (hosted inference)
- $120,000 one-time credit (applied at renewal)
- SLA addendum: 99.9% with credits capped at 10% of monthly invoice; Product has approved the draft addendum attached
- Term reset to 12 months (auto-renew) with a 10% price protection cap on the first 90 days post-reset

Why this is time-sensitive:
- Customer has a signed LOI with a competitor for a pilot if we don’t respond by COB Friday (11/17).
- Mercari is a strategic reference for APAC expansion and influences other marketplaces.

Request:
- Marissa: exec signoff to authorize the 18% discount + $120k credit and the SLA addendum as drafted. If you need tighter pricing I can rework incentives (multi-year, usage floors).
- Ben: if you can confirm finance/legal tolerances for the credit structure and SLA cap by EOD, I’ll communicate to Olivia and lock the DocuSign link.

Attachments: mercari_proposed_pricing_v3.xlsx (line-item P&L), sla_addendum_draft_mercari.pdf

Thanks —
Nikhil
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-16T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mercari renewal - ask for senior approval: concession + SLA addendum

Nikhil —

Thanks for the summary. Couple of clarifying asks before I can sign off:
1) Provide a short sensitivity table showing ARR impact at -18% vs -22% discount (3 rows) and the payback timeline if Mercari reduces committed usage by 20%. Put that in the pricing sheet.
2) Legal needs the SLA credit wording tightened — specifically define "downtime" measure and exclude planned maintenance windows. Can you loop legal and ask Product to accept the tightened language?
3) Is this the final ask from the customer or are they expecting additional credits if they hit the competitor’s pilot metrics?

If the numbers are within the thresholds we discussed in Q3 rev ops, I’m comfortable approving the credit and SLA addendum. Send me the updated sheet and a 1-paragraph justification I can paste into the approval ticket.

Marissa
VP, Renewals & Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-11-16T13:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mercari renewal - ask for senior approval: concession + SLA addendum

Marissa — thank you. I updated the pricing workbook and the justification paragraph (see attached). High level notes:
- Sensitivity table added: shows net ARR impact with -18% = $984k vs -22% = $936k; payback at -18% remains positive within 10 months under current usage estimates.
- Product accepted the tightened SLA language; draft now includes specific "service outage" definition (loss of inference response for >30s across >5% of requests) and excludes scheduled maintenance windows with 72hr notice.
- Customer confirmed the competitor pilot is limited to a 60-day pilot on a single service; they told me they will not ask for additional credits beyond what's discussed if we respond with the SLA and credit.

Attached: mercari_proposed_pricing_v3.xlsx (updated), sla_addendum_draft_mercari.pdf, approval_justification.txt

Please approve so I can send to Olivia and request countersignature this afternoon.

Thanks —
Nikhil
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-11-16T17:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mercari renewal - ask for senior approval: concession + SLA addendum

Approved.

Ben (on behalf of deal desk steering) has reviewed the numbers and the Finance caveats. Approve the package: 18% recurring discount, $120,000 one-time credit, SLA addendum with the tightened outage wording, and term reset as proposed.

Conditions:
- Credit to be amortized over the first invoice cycle and recorded as a one-time contra-revenue line item; finance will confirm accounting treatment on the DocuSign.
- Legal to sign off on final SLA doc before sending to customer. Nikhil, do not send to customer until Legal confirms.

Nikhil — you have authority to proceed to customer outreach once Legal confirms the final doc. I'll be available for any follow-up.

Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
